name: Island Resort -Kettou Okihimejima Bunkou-
original_name: あいらんど・りぞーと-決闘沖姫島分校-
source:
Main character transfers to a school on a resort island because of his father, who gets appointed at work to be responsible for island development. However, opposition campaign has burst out to prevent reconstruction of the island, and the protests wave reached the school as well. Supporting the the right to develop the island, protagonist enters a surrogate war at school where the battles are held via mahjong game.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角因为父亲的工作而转学到度假岛上的一所学校，父亲在工作中被任命负责岛屿开发。然而，反对派却爆发了阻止该岛重建的运动，抗议浪潮也波及到了学校。主角为了维护岛屿的开发权，在学校里展开了一场代理战争，并通过麻将游戏进行了战斗。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
